name: sensei_task_categorize_sure
description: Task categorize_for_recall dispatches on sure confidence from classify
input:
use
  llm.classify

task categorize_for_recall
  needs context: Text
  gives Text
  do
    result = classify context into ["SYNTAX", "TASKS", "FLOWS", "CONTROL", "AGENTS", "KNOWLEDGE", "SUPERVISION", "PRINCIPLES", "PATTERNS", "ERRORS", "CONFORMANCE", "BOUNDARY"]
    when result.sure -> give result
    when result.unsure -> give result
    else -> give "GENERAL"

fn main
  result = categorize_for_recall("How do you define a task with needs and gives?")
  say result
